note: Off-nominal scenarios. prior_prob is SYNTH: a synthesized planning prior per 1 h session, NEVER a measured rate. engine_mode links to scenario_engine failure modes. false_confidence refers to docs/SIM-BLOCKERS.md section 5 (F1..F19).

scenarios.title: AIR adapter thermal derate then shutdown

prior_prob.rationale: closed enclosure + sun + 28 dBm PA; hot-day flights are a minority of sessions

scenarios.trigger: ambient > 35 C, enclosure in the sun, TX at flight power for > 10 min
scenarios.symptom: video loss rises gradually, then link drops for a cooldown; wfb-cli shows RSSI falling at the AIR side
scenarios.detection: VTX temperature telemetry (majestic), RSSI trend vs time; thermal alarm in OSD
scenarios.mitigation: fan, heatsink, lower txpower, shade; ground-test 30 min at flight power
scenarios.detection_test: engine scenario hot_day_closed_case: P(thermal_derate) and P(thermal_shutdown) must exceed the nominal scenario; on HW log Tj vs time

scenarios.title: USB3 / ELRS-900 harmonic / Multi 2.4 GHz desense of the GS receiver

prior_prob.rationale: Pi 5 USB3 ports, TX12 modules a few cm from the dongle; effect on 5.8 GHz unverified

scenarios.trigger: USB3 device active, or ELRS 900 / Multi 2.4 module transmitting next to the dongle
scenarios.symptom: noise floor rises 2..10 dB, range shrinks, FEC exhausted at edge of range
scenarios.detection: compare noise floor/PER with modules and USB3 devices off vs on at fixed attenuation
scenarios.mitigation: dongle on a USB2 port or extension cable, ferrites, antenna spacing, module power down
scenarios.detection_test: engine scenario elrs_usb3_desense_edge at 900 m: P(desense) > nominal; HW: switch modules on/off while logging wfb-cli loss

scenarios.title: Brown-out of the AIR supply on a TX burst

prior_prob.rationale: BEC marginal at 28 dBm with a loaded ESC rail

scenarios.trigger: txpower raised to 25+ dBm with a weak BEC, battery sag at full throttle
scenarios.symptom: periodic dips in RSSI, EVM rise, VTX reboot at worst
scenarios.detection: scope on the 5 V pad; majestic log reboots
scenarios.mitigation: stronger BEC, LC filter, lower txpower
scenarios.detection_test: engine: P(thermal/sag) via hw.air_* priors; unit test compression + sag lowers Pout

scenarios.title: GS USB re-enumeration mid-flight

prior_prob.rationale: Pi 5 USB under TX bursts on a 3 A PSU or thin cable

scenarios.trigger: undervoltage on the 5 V rail, over-current trip, spontaneous disconnect
scenarios.symptom: video freezes 3-10 s then returns only if bring-up reruns; wfb_rx loses the interface
scenarios.detection: dmesg 'USB disconnect', udev remove/add, wfb-ng restart count
scenarios.mitigation: 5 A PSU + usb_max_current_enable, short thick cable, systemd restart policy for wfb-ng
scenarios.detection_test: virt usb: hot-unplug the dwc2/vudc device and check gs-mavlink + wfb restart; engine pi5_3a_weak_psu: P(usb_dropout|usb_trip)

scenarios.title: Pi 5 USB current-limit trip (600 mA vs 1.6 A)

prior_prob.rationale: 3 A PSUs are common and the doc'd limit is 0.6 A without usb_max_current_enable

scenarios.trigger: 3 A PSU, adapter + FC + fan on USB, TX burst
scenarios.symptom: adapter vanishes at every TX burst; repeated trips, latched port
scenarios.detection: dmesg over-current, get_throttled, lsusb after burst
scenarios.mitigation: 5 A PSU or usb_max_current_enable=1, bus-powered devices on a powered hub
scenarios.detection_test: engine pi5_3a_weak_psu: P(usb_trip)=1 for 3 A without the flag (power_model budget); virt usb gadget removal replays the events

scenarios.title: Wrong channel / channel clash with a neighbour

prior_prob.rationale: 5.8 GHz is shared with other FPV/Wi-Fi; regdomain-agnostic channel choice

scenarios.trigger: two systems on the same channel, DFS/regdomain differences
scenarios.symptom: bursty loss episodes, RSSI normal but SNR low
scenarios.detection: channel-scan.sh survey at the site; loss bursts in wfb-cli
scenarios.mitigation: channel scan before flight, move channel, regdomain check
scenarios.detection_test: qemu_hwsim negative control (other channel hears nothing) proves isolation; engine ext.clash_* gives burst_outage probability

scenarios.title: GCS heartbeat loss (MAVLink GCS timeout)

prior_prob.rationale: wifi/hotspot dropouts and a bridge that stays alive

scenarios.trigger: GCS heartbeat stops (host sleep, router crash) with FS_GCS_ENABLE set
scenarios.symptom: ArduPilot GCS failsafe (RTL/LAND) or, if FS_GCS_ENABLE=0, none
scenarios.detection: apm_fc/SITL timeline 'GCS Failsafe'; HEARTBEAT age in gs_mav
scenarios.mitigation: set FS_GCS_ENABLE deliberately, heartbeat source documented, never rely on the bridge heartbeat
scenarios.detection_test: smoke mavlink path: fake_fc/apm_fc timeouts; sitl_probe failsafe observations

scenarios.title: ELRS failsafe plus stale wfb RC override (ArduPilot #32862)

prior_prob.rationale: override and receiver interplay is an open upstream issue (status unverifiable here)

scenarios.trigger: ELRS link lost while a wfb RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE is still active or reverts to stale RC values
scenarios.symptom: FC follows an old override or stale RC instead of failsafe
scenarios.detection: apm_fc rc_input model (#32862 behaviour); RCIN log on HIL
scenarios.mitigation: wfb RC strictly as a reserve with expiry; failsafe on no pulses; never the sole channel
scenarios.detection_test: apm_model test of override expiry and revert-to-stale; HIL: pull the ELRS antenna with the bridge running

scenarios.title: FC UART overrun / baud mismatch on the WiFiLink2 single UART

prior_prob.rationale: one UART shared by MAVLink and possibly msposd/mavfwd; wrong baud after a firmware change

scenarios.trigger: baud differs between SERIALx_BAUD and the VTX, or two services read the port
scenarios.symptom: MAVLink CRC errors, missing telemetry, heartbeats flicker
scenarios.detection: mavlink-router stats, link CRC counter, SERIAL port stats
scenarios.mitigation: pin baud in config, single reader, CRC check in smoke
scenarios.detection_test: gs_mav.py --selftest with corrupted frames; HW: change baud and watch CRC counters

scenarios.title: majestic bitrate overshoot beyond the airtime

prior_prob.rationale: rate control overshoots and the configured bitrate is close to the link capacity

scenarios.trigger: bitrate x overshoot x n/k exceeds the air utilisation
scenarios.symptom: queue drops, growing latency, I-frame loss, freezes
scenarios.detection: airtime utilisation in rf_model, injection drops, freeze fraction
scenarios.mitigation: bitrate with 30 % headroom, lower MCS cost awareness, alink
scenarios.detection_test: engine: rho > 1 sets injection_overload; wfb_veth with relay at the model's loss; rf_model utilisation > 1 flag

scenarios.title: IDR loss causes a long freeze

prior_prob.rationale: one lost I-frame breaks the whole GOP; GOP of 1-2 s

scenarios.trigger: I-frame packets unrecoverable after FEC
scenarios.symptom: video frozen/garbled until the next IDR (up to GOP seconds)
scenarios.detection: freeze fraction, decoder errors, missing IDR counter
scenarios.mitigation: shorter GOP, intra refresh, IDR request, FEC 8/12 tuned
scenarios.detection_test: engine freeze_fraction monotone in loss; smoke video with induced loss via air_relay and a keyframe-gap check

scenarios.title: Driver built for 4K pages breaks on Pi 5 16K pages

prior_prob.rationale: Pi 5 default kernel uses 16K pages; out-of-tree drivers were written for 4K

scenarios.trigger: rtl8812au loaded on rpi-2712 16K
scenarios.symptom: probe fails or memory corruption, no wlan interface
scenarios.detection: dkms status, dmesg, iw dev empty
scenarios.mitigation: use kernel8 (4K) on Pi 5 or a fixed driver; pin the kernel
scenarios.detection_test: tests/sim/dkms builds against the rpi-2712 headers; runtime proof only on HW

scenarios.title: DKMS module breaks after a kernel upgrade

prior_prob.rationale: apt upgrade changes the kernel and API

scenarios.trigger: apt upgrade installs a newer kernel
scenarios.symptom: no wlan interface after reboot
scenarios.detection: dkms status in check.sh, modinfo vermagic vs uname -r
scenarios.mitigation: apt-mark hold kernel, dkms autoinstall check, rollback image
scenarios.detection_test: dkms run.sh --build against two header sets; static check that the hold/dkms status step exists

scenarios.title: SD-card corruption / overlayroot absent

prior_prob.rationale: power loss during recording and no read-only root on Pi (docs/PI-PORT.md)

scenarios.trigger: power cut while writing recordings or logs
scenarios.symptom: fsck on boot, services fail, read-only remount
scenarios.detection: journalctl, dmesg ext4 errors
scenarios.mitigation: overlayroot, separate recording partition, 20 power-cut test
scenarios.detection_test: HW: 20 power-cuts during recording; sandbox golden tests cannot show it

scenarios.title: Pi 5 SoC throttling

prior_prob.rationale: no cooler, hot enclosure, software decode load

scenarios.trigger: SoC temp above the soft limit
scenarios.symptom: decode slows, latency rises, frames dropped
scenarios.detection: vcgencmd get_throttled bit 3/19, latency tracer
scenarios.mitigation: cooler/fan, HEVC hardware decode, lower resolution
scenarios.detection_test: engine hw.soc_* priors: P(soc_throttle) and latency impact; HW vcgencmd log

scenarios.title: Host Wayland / GStreamer sink failure

prior_prob.rationale: Ubuntu 26.04 has newer GStreamer 1.28 and Wayland default; our CI runs 24.04

scenarios.trigger: sink element missing or compositor refuses
scenarios.symptom: black window, pipeline error, no video on the host
scenarios.detection: gst-launch exit code, pipeline bus errors
scenarios.mitigation: fallback sink chain (waylandsink -> glimagesink -> fakesink) selected by probe
scenarios.detection_test: smoke video with SINK=fakesink vs a forced bad sink: pipeline must fail loudly; HW on the 26.04 host

scenarios.title: Clock step by NTP

prior_prob.rationale: no RTC on Pi, first NTP sync steps the clock

scenarios.trigger: chrony/NTP steps the wall clock while logging or recording
scenarios.symptom: log timestamps jump, recording file names collide, wall-clock latency probes break; /proc/uptime unaffected
scenarios.detection: journal 'time stepped', monotonic vs wall-clock diff
scenarios.mitigation: use CLOCK_MONOTONIC for intervals; button.sh uses /proc/uptime (immune)
scenarios.detection_test: clock_events() produces ntp_step events; unit test that button timing does not depend on wall time

scenarios.title: TX12 enumerates as a different USB device node / event number

prior_prob.rationale: evdev numbers change with plug order and with other HID devices

scenarios.trigger: replug, second HID, EdgeTX mode change
scenarios.symptom: tx12_bridge opens the wrong device, no RC or wrong axes
scenarios.detection: by-id path check, device name check at start
scenarios.mitigation: open by /dev/input/by-id and name match, refuse if ambiguous
scenarios.detection_test: virt: create two uinput devices in swapped order and require the bridge to pick the TX12 by name

scenarios.title: evdev axis reorder (EdgeTX mixes)

prior_prob.rationale: EdgeTX model change reorders channels

scenarios.trigger: different model loaded on the TX12
scenarios.symptom: channels 1-4 land on the wrong RC channels
scenarios.detection: assert channel map against a known pattern at start
scenarios.mitigation: channel map in config with a start-up wiggle check
scenarios.detection_test: tx12_bridge --input sweep with permuted axes must be rejected by a map check

scenarios.title: Button bounce causes a false long/short press

prior_prob.rationale: mechanical switch, long wires, vibration; gs/button.sh has only a 50 ms settle

scenarios.trigger: press on a bouncy switch, chatter during a long hold
scenarios.symptom: single press fires twice or long press fires as single(s)
scenarios.detection: bounce trace JSON + algorithm replay (gpio_bounce.py)
scenarios.mitigation: debounce in libgpiod (debounce period), hardware RC filter, state machine
scenarios.detection_test: gpio_bounce.py trace JSON is fed to gpio-sim; test: false-event probability falls with debounce

scenarios.title: udev rename race for wifi0 / rpi0

prior_prob.rationale: rename rules race with NetworkManager and driver load

scenarios.trigger: adapter probe order changes
scenarios.symptom: interface named wlan1 not wifiX; scripts act on the wrong iface
scenarios.detection: udevadm test, ip link after boot
scenarios.mitigation: match by MAC/driver, wait for rename before starting services
scenarios.detection_test: virt radio: create hwsim radios in swapped order and check rename; udevadm verify

scenarios.title: wfb key mismatch after reflash

prior_prob.rationale: gs.key is created on the VTX SD card at first boot; reflash regenerates it

scenarios.trigger: VTX reflashed or SD replaced
scenarios.symptom: wfb_rx accepts nothing, no video, 'no session key' errors
scenarios.detection: wfb-cli shows no sessions; key fingerprint compare
scenarios.mitigation: print/compare key fingerprints in bring-up, backup keys
scenarios.detection_test: qemu_hwsim negative control (unrelated keypair accepts nothing) is the detection

scenarios.title: alink oscillation (adaptive bitrate flapping)

prior_prob.rationale: the controller reacts to loss bursts with delay

scenarios.trigger: loss bursts near the link margin
scenarios.symptom: bitrate and quality oscillate, latency saw-tooth
scenarios.detection: bitrate time series
scenarios.mitigation: hysteresis, longer averaging, floor on bitrate
scenarios.detection_test: engine: g2g tail and freeze under burst chain; veth ramp via relay_from_model with a loop that toggles bitrate

scenarios.title: Latency creep from GStreamer queue growth

prior_prob.rationale: producer/consumer clock mismatch, no leaky queue

scenarios.trigger: hours-long run with ppm drift
scenarios.symptom: glass-to-glass grows by tens of ms until frames drop
scenarios.detection: latency tracer over 30 min
scenarios.mitigation: leaky queues, sync=false/low-latency sink, periodic reset
scenarios.detection_test: engine timing.clock_ppm: P(latency_creep); smoke video_latency.py p95 trend over a long run

scenarios.title: Decoder stall / buffer backlog

prior_prob.rationale: decode load spikes, GC, USB

scenarios.trigger: hiccup in the decoder or sink
scenarios.symptom: single frozen second, then latency raised until catch-up
scenarios.detection: stall counters, latency steps
scenarios.mitigation: queue limits, catch-up policy
scenarios.detection_test: engine stall process adds backlog; check that latency recovers

scenarios.title: AGC saturation at very close range

prior_prob.rationale: bench testing at 1-3 m with 28 dBm

scenarios.trigger: RX level above the AGC knee
scenarios.symptom: high loss at short range, better at 20 m
scenarios.detection: PER vs attenuation sweep
scenarios.mitigation: attenuate on the bench, lower txpower at short range
scenarios.detection_test: engine scenario close_range_agc: P(agc_saturation) near 1; hw.rx_agc_* calibration sweep

scenarios.title: USB probe failure / timeout at boot

prior_prob.rationale: marginal supply, hub, long cable

scenarios.trigger: cold boot or hot-plug
scenarios.symptom: no wlan interface until retry
scenarios.detection: dmesg 'device descriptor read error -71'
scenarios.mitigation: retry with backoff, uhubctl power cycle
scenarios.detection_test: engine bringup(): analytic vs Monte-Carlo success; virt usb: delayed gadget attach

scenarios.title: Monitor-mode set fails (device busy)

prior_prob.rationale: NetworkManager/rfkill/other process holds the iface

scenarios.trigger: iw set type monitor with NM managing the device
scenarios.symptom: wfb_rx cannot open the iface
scenarios.detection: exit code of iw, nmcli device status
scenarios.mitigation: unmanaged-devices in NM, retry
scenarios.detection_test: virt radio hwsim: set monitor while an NM-like process holds it; assert the script retries

scenarios.title: Injection EBUSY / queue full

prior_prob.rationale: driver TX queue overflows under bursts

scenarios.trigger: I-frame burst larger than queue
scenarios.symptom: dropped data and parity, FEC cannot cover
scenarios.detection: send errors counter in wfb_tx
scenarios.mitigation: bitrate cap, bigger queue, pacing
scenarios.detection_test: engine M/M/1/K block probability monotone in utilisation; wfb_veth with relay loss as the proxy

scenarios.title: FEC exhausted at the edge of range

prior_prob.rationale: link margin shrinks in nulls/shadow; FEC 8/12 tolerates 4 of 12

scenarios.trigger: SNR margin < 0 for several seconds
scenarios.symptom: bursty video loss
scenarios.detection: residual loss and margin in the engine; wfb-cli
scenarios.mitigation: lower MCS, FEC k/n, antenna diversity
scenarios.detection_test: engine fec_exhaust probability; veth relay at the model's loss for the same distance

scenarios.title: Noise-floor shock (nearby transmitter, ESC)

prior_prob.rationale: Poisson shocks from ESC/other transmitters

scenarios.trigger: motor spin-up, neighbour transmitter starts
scenarios.symptom: short outage, retrain
scenarios.detection: noise floor log
scenarios.mitigation: shielding, routing, channel change
scenarios.detection_test: engine proc.shock_* : availability falls monotonically with the shock rate

scenarios.title: FC / VTX ground reference (UART) noise from ESC

prior_prob.rationale: ESC noise couples into UART

scenarios.trigger: motors at high throttle
scenarios.symptom: CRC errors, dropped telemetry
scenarios.detection: UART error counters
scenarios.mitigation: twisted pair, ferrites, short wires
scenarios.detection_test: HW only: LQ and UART errors with motors spinning, props off

scenarios.title: Wi-Fi hotspot / LAN loss between Pi and host

prior_prob.rationale: single point: wired/wireless link of the host display

scenarios.trigger: hotspot reconnects, cable unplugged
scenarios.symptom: video freeze, GCS lost
scenarios.detection: ping loss, link state
scenarios.mitigation: wired link, restart policy
scenarios.detection_test: smoke router/video with the link down mid-run (veth down) must recover

scenarios.title: Wrong regdomain limits TX power / channels

prior_prob.rationale: regdomain default differs from the planned channel

scenarios.trigger: wrong country code on the GS or VTX
scenarios.symptom: txpower capped, channel unavailable
scenarios.detection: iw reg get, iw list
scenarios.mitigation: set regdomain in bring-up, verify channel/power
scenarios.detection_test: virt radio: iw reg set and assert the chosen channel is allowed; static check of the config

scenarios.title: Pi 5 PSU undervoltage (throttled word)

prior_prob.rationale: cheap 5 V supplies and thin cables

scenarios.trigger: TX burst plus load on 5.1 V with a 0.15 ohm path
scenarios.symptom: undervoltage flag, USB drops, throttling
scenarios.detection: get_throttled 0x50005, dmesg
scenarios.mitigation: 5 A PSU, thick cable
scenarios.detection_test: engine undervoltage flag from power_model budget; power_model throttled decode tests

scenarios.title: Latency spec exceeded by scheduling spikes

prior_prob.rationale: load on the host (GPU, other apps)

scenarios.trigger: CPU contention
scenarios.symptom: occasional 100+ ms latency spikes
scenarios.detection: latency p95/p99 tracer
scenarios.mitigation: pin cores, priority, lighter host load
scenarios.detection_test: engine sched_spike_*: g2g tail percentile; smoke video latency p95 as a regression guard

scenarios.title: Bring-up never finishes (stage fails after retries)

prior_prob.rationale: stacked failures of probe/monitor/injection

scenarios.trigger: several stages fail in sequence
scenarios.symptom: service gives up, GS idle
scenarios.detection: bring-up log, systemd status
scenarios.mitigation: watchdog + escalating power-cycle of the adapter
scenarios.detection_test: engine bringup_fail probability vs max_attempts
